text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On my way back to the waiting room
after the
race, a reporter corners me.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me. I'm Etsuko Otonashi from Twinkle Monthly.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I had the pleasure of watching the race
firsthand,
and I'd just like to commend
you on all your hard
work.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
It's a shame she didn't get first place,
but your
trainee really put her unique
personality on full
display with her
performance.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer, how do you intend to steer
your ship
back on course?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: How interesting...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
More flexible regimen, confer with the
director
about anything the academy
lacks... All for the
sake of the
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Taking your results in stride while
looking ahead
to your next race—just
what I'd expect from a
Tracen trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Looks like I handled that pretty well!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I then tell <chrname> about
the
successful interview and praise her
hard work.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Considering these results, I
expected
to hear somewhat more
concrete plans...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your statement. I hope
you find
more success in the next race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like I wasn't able to make a
good
impression on the reporter...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide not to mention the interview
when I go to
praise
<chrname> for her hard
work.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
S-simply amazing! I should have
expected no less
from a Tracen
Academy trainer!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
You're saying you simply need to draw
out her
innate abilities, right?! Of
course! All she needs is
a little strategy
and experience!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
And now you plan to forgo sleep and
devise
countless clever stratagems?!
Naturally! Anything
to help your trainee
claim victory!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
The deep trust you have for one
another—it's
simply overwhelming!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
The next feature article is decided! I
have to talk
to the editor-in-chief right
away!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It feels like my statement was taken way
out of
proportion, but I guess I handled
the interview
well enough.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I then go and tell <chrname>
about
the interview and praise her hard
work.
